statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
There is concern for undiagnosed paroxysmal atrial fibrillation as a potential embolic source
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events
The service aims to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The study aims to guide anticoagulation therapy and rate control management
The study aims to address diagnosis code I48.91
Diagnosis codes G45.9, I48.91, and R00.2 were submitted
The claim was denied based on reason code CO-197
The denial was because required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date
